name: claude-qa-skills
description: Quality-engineering and developer skills for Claude Code: test strategy, shift-left design, unit and mutation testing, automation, exploratory testing, CI insights, release, DORA metrics, Evidence-Based Management, AI-era quality, business software (ERP, e-invoicing, SaaS), plus developer plugins for agentic workflow, .NET, Angular, SQL Server, legacy code, Azure DevOps delivery and security.

plugins.name: qa-test-strategy
plugins.description: One-page strategy, testing quadrants, measured test pyramid, quality-attribute scenarios, risk storming, environments, test data, shift-right, automation roadmap, QA maturity.

plugins.name: qa-shift-left
plugins.description: Testable stories, example mapping, risk-based test plans, test design techniques, pairwise, Gherkin, French test data, export to Azure Test Plans / Xray.

plugins.name: qa-unit-testing
plugins.description: Unit tests with Arrange-Act-Assert, TDD red-green-refactor with an agent, test doubles, parameterised tests, testability refactoring, assertion quality.

plugins.name: qa-mutation-testing
plugins.description: Mutation testing setup per stack, report digest, surviving and equivalent mutant triage, mutant-killer tests, CI gate on changed code.

plugins.name: qa-automation
plugins.description: Playwright E2E, API suites, contract and property-based testing, k6, accessibility, visual regression, characterization tests, test-smell review.

plugins.name: qa-explore-and-report
plugins.description: Exploratory charters (SFDIPOT, tours), session debriefs, FEW HICCUPPS oracles, bug reports, batch triage, repro minimisation.

plugins.name: qa-ci-insights
plugins.description: Flaky tests across runs, JUnit digests, regression scope from git history, CI failure triage, risk-weighted coverage gaps.

plugins.name: qa-release
plugins.description: Go/no-go readiness, post-deployment smoke plans, quality flow metrics, escaped-defect analysis.

plugins.name: dora-metrics
plugins.description: The five DORA metrics: calculator, data sources, quick check, capability-based improvement plan, monthly review (AI adoption included).

plugins.name: evidence-based-management
plugins.description: EBM goals, key value measures across CV/UV/T2M/A2I, scorecard script, experiment loop, EBM reviews.

plugins.name: qa-ai-era
plugins.description: Review AI-generated PRs, tests first for agents, evidence before done, audit AI-written tests, LLM feature evals, prompt-injection red-teaming.

plugins.name: qa-business-apps
plugins.description: Accounting invariants, e-invoice (Factur-X/CII) checks, money and rounding, dates and time zones, multi-tenant isolation, RBAC matrices, migrations, localisation.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Explore before editing, plan in files, root-cause debugging, small PRs (size script), PR descriptions, self-review, receiving review, worktrees, handoff.

plugins.name: dev-dotnet
plugins.description: Solution inventory (frameworks, support status, package drift), .NET Framework to .NET 10 upgrade, modern C#, .NET testing, EF Core performance and migrations, NuGet hygiene.

plugins.name: dev-web
plugins.description: Angular modernisation, TypeScript strictness, accessibility to WCAG 2.2 and RGAA 4.1, internationalisation of dates, numbers and currencies.

plugins.name: dev-data
plugins.description: SQL Server tuning, zero-downtime schema changes, multi-tenant isolation, GDPR (RGPD) by design.

plugins.name: dev-legacy
plugins.description: Hotspots from git history (script), strangler fig, TFVC to Git, release backports with a missing-fix report (script), dead-code removal.

plugins.name: dev-delivery
plugins.description: Azure Pipelines YAML, work-item linking and WIQL, Conventional Commits and changelog (script), stale PR triage (script), feature flags, blameless incident reviews.

plugins.name: dev-security
plugins.description: Secure code review (OWASP, .NET and Angular), STRIDE threat model, insecure defaults, supply chain and SBOM, secrets hygiene with a pre-commit scanner (script).
